result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: The statutory requirements apply except as otherwise required by statute.
claims.quote: (a) Except as otherwise required by statute,

claims.claim: The summons must be directed to the defendant.
claims.quote: a summons shall be directed to the defendant

claims.claim: The clerk must sign the summons.
claims.quote: signed by the clerk

claims.claim: The summons must be issued under the seal of the court where the action is pending.
claims.quote: issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending

claims.claim: The summons must contain the court title.
claims.quote: (1) The title of the court in which the action is pending.

claims.claim: The summons must contain the parties’ names.
claims.quote: (2) The names of the parties to the action.

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written pleading with the court in response to the complaint.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint

claims.claim: The stated filing deadline is 30 days after the summons is served on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The summons must warn that, absent that response, default will be entered upon the plaintiff’s application.
claims.quote: (4) A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff

claims.claim: The notice must state that the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint

claims.claim: The notice must identify wage garnishment, taking of money or property, or other relief as possible outcomes.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.

claims.claim: The statutory attorney-consultation statement must appear in boldface.
claims.quote: (5) The following statement in boldface type:  “You may seek the advice of an attorney in any matter connected with the complaint or this summons. Such attorney should be consulted promptly so that your pleading may be filed or entered within the time required by this summons.”
claims.note: The draft quotes both sentences exactly.

claims.claim: The introductory legend must appear at the top above all other matter.
claims.quote: (6) The following introductory legend at the top of the summons above all other matter

claims.claim: The legend must be in boldface.
claims.quote: above all other matter, in boldface type

claims.claim: The legend must be in English and Spanish.
claims.quote: in English and Spanish:

claims.claim: The quoted statutory legend gives notice of suit, warns of a decision without a hearing unless the recipient responds within 30 days, and directs the recipient to read below.
claims.quote: “Notice!  You have been sued.  The court may decide against you without your being heard unless you respond within 30 days.  Read information below.”
claims.note: The draft reproduces the legend exactly.

claims.claim: A county may by ordinance require the legend in an additional foreign language on every summons issued out of that county’s courts.
claims.quote: (b) Each county may, by ordinance, require that the legend contained in paragraph (6) of subdivision (a) be set forth in every summons issued out of the courts of that county in any additional foreign language

claims.claim: The additional-language legend must follow the same placement and boldface requirements.
claims.quote: if the legend in the additional foreign language is set forth in the summons in the same manner as required in that paragraph.

claims.claim: A summons in a Judicial Council-approved form is deemed to comply with the section.
claims.quote: (c) A summons in a form approved by the Judicial Council is deemed to comply with this section.

claims.claim: SUM-100 is the Judicial Council summons form.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons)

claims.claim: The form’s revision date is July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: SUM-100 [Rev. July 1, 2009]

claims.claim: The form displays “NOTICE! You have been sued.”
claims.quote: NOTICE! You have been sued.

claims.claim: The form has a case-number field.
claims.quote: CASE NUMBER:

claims.claim: The form has a field for the court’s name and address.
claims.quote: The name and address of the court is:

claims.claim: The form has a field for the name and address of the plaintiff or the plaintiff’s attorney.
claims.quote: The name, address, and telephone number of plaintiff's attorney, or plaintiff without an attorney, is:
claims.note: The field identifies the attorney if the plaintiff has one, and the plaintiff otherwise. It also asks for a telephone number.

result.summary: The provided statute supports the ordinary civil summons requirements within the stated scope. The supplied SUM-100 supports the revision date, notice wording, and identifying fields.
